sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:1
items.html: This answer, on cause and consequence, is a continuation of the answer on cause and consequence brought in Part 7, Answer 155, and in Part 6, Answer 164. There, the obligation of cause and consequence was explained from restriction one and the beginning of the line of Ein Sof, until the end of the expansion of the new vessels of Nekudim that came out after the breaking of the vessels was completed. And here we will continue to explain the obligation of cause and consequence, from the return of the expansion of Nekudim, until the birth of the soul of Adam HaRishon, and until the falling of the organs of his soul after the sin of the Tree of Knowledge.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:2
items.html: Let us begin with what we ended there in the answer of Part 7, namely action 103 mentioned there at the end of the answer, which is the matter of the record of Malchut descending to the new vessel of Tifferet that was made from the posterior of Yeshsut and from the head of the level of MA, which clothed that posterior. And with this, the clothing of the records of the seven kings that remained in Nekudim was completed, within the expansion of the new vessels: of HGT NH, which were made from the posterior of AVI and Yeshsut that fell into the place of those vessels. However, the level of ZA that came out there from below upward did not remain so, but rather the screen was fully refined of all the coarseness of the body that was in it, as is the custom in all Partzufim.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:3
items.html: Action 1. It is the refinement of all the coarseness of the body that was in the screen of Nekudim, as mentioned just above. And from this action four actions followed: 2, 3, 4, 5.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:4
items.html: Action 2. The cessation of every aspect of coupling from the screen, and the cancellation of the entire illumination of the new light that broke through the Parsa, which brought the bottom Hey down from the eyes. For as long as any aspect of coarseness and coupling still remained in the screen, even a coupling of phase one, the power of the illumination of the coupling of AB SAG, which had cancelled the boundary of restriction two and broken through the Parsa, still continued to be drawn. But after all the coarseness had finished from the screen, and no aspect of coupling remained there, the illumination of AB SAG was likewise cancelled of itself. And this action is a consequence of the refinement of the screen, as explained.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:5
items.html: Action 3, the return of the joining of the two Heys: the bottom Hey into the first Hey. For restriction two returned to its place. And this is a consequence of action 2, which is the cancellation of the power of the coupling of AB SAG.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:6
items.html: Action 4 is the ascent of the screen to the head of SAG. And this is a consequence of the refinement of the screen, mentioned above. For the departure of the screen from its coarseness is considered an ascent, and once the refinement of all the coarseness of the body was complete, it is considered to have ascended to the head of the one above it, for it had equalized its form with the one above.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:7
items.html: Action 5 is the inclusion of all the records of the expansion of Nekudim within the screen, at the time of its joining in the head of the one above it. And this is a consequence of action 4, of the ascent of the screen, for in the ascent of the screen through the degree, it is found to be included in every degree that it refined and reached, since all the degrees that came out, came out only through the coupling that was on the screen, and hence the screen is included from all the degrees that were in Nekudim, from beginning to end. And these records are considered in two divisions: one is from the degrees that came out in Nekudim over the records of the lower nine Sefirot of SAG, namely those coming from the coupling in the Nikvey Einayim of SAG, for the screen of SAG that was refined to phase one, which is the coarseness of Hochma, is considered to have made the coupling in the Nikvey Einayim. And the second kind of records are those coming from the NHY of AK, which rose as MAN to AB SAG of AK, and from their coupling the new light that broke through the Parsa descended, as is known. And these records of the second kind divide likewise into two: one is from the illumination of the new light through the Tabur of AK, and the second is from its illumination through the Yesod of AK. And you already know that from the records of the first kind, the three heads of Nekudim came out in Katnut, and from the records of the second kind, which are the aspect of the vapor of the Tabur, comes the Gadlut of the three heads mentioned. And the records of the second kind from the aspect of the Yesod are the seven kings of Nekudim.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:8
items.html: Action 6 is the coupling made at the place of the forehead, namely in Keter. And this follows from action 5 mentioned above, from the first kind of records, which is the continuation of the screen of SAG that was refined, which in Nekudim was refined to phase one, and the coupling was made in the eyes; and here, after the screen was refined also from the aspect of Nekudim, nothing remained in the screen except the record of the coarseness of Keter, for the last phase is always lost through refinement, and only the aspect of clothing alone remains of it, as is known. Hence the coupling was made at the place of Keter, namely according to the record that remained in the screen, and ten Sefirot at the level of Malchut alone came out over it, except that it also contains an aspect of ZA of clothing, as will be explained below.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:9
items.html: Action 7, the ten Sefirot in the aspect of three within three, meaning that the three Sefirot of HGT are included within the three Sefirot NHY. And this follows from action 6, that the coupling was made at the place of the forehead, meaning that the screen contained only the record of the coarseness of Keter, and the level that comes out over the coarseness of Keter is only the level of Malchut alone, as is known. However, since the aspect of phase one of clothing is also there, which is the male aspect within the record, as explained in Answer 61, hence the level of ZA of clothing came out over it, meaning through the inclusion in the record of Keter of the female. However, this male level has no vessels to clothe in, and it clothes in the vessels of the female, namely at the level of Malchut. And the reason the level of Malchut is called NHY is because of the correction of the lines within it, for you already know that all the records were corrected in the correction of the lines through their clothing in the new vessels that were made in Nekudim from the posterior of AVI and Yeshsut, as explained in the answer of cause and consequence in Part 7. Hence there are three lines in the ten Sefirot of the level of Malchut, where the right line is called Netzah, the left line is called Hod, and the middle line is called Yesod. And likewise the level of the ten Sefirot of the male divides, where the right line is called Hesed, the left line is called Gevura, and the middle line is called Tifferet. Hence this is called three within three, meaning HGT within NHY, since HGT have no vessels of their own, as explained, and are compelled to clothe in the vessels of NHY of the female.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:10
items.html: Action 8. The coupling was made only over the records of the upper half of the point of Keter of Nekudim. And this follows from action 6, that the coupling was made at the place of the forehead, namely only over the first kind of records, which is the aspect of the Katnut of the three heads of Nekudim, as above in action 5, see there. Except that there is a change here, for in Nekudim all three heads came out in Katnut one after another, and afterward the entire Gadlut of the three heads also came out together, as explained in the answer of cause and consequence in Part 6. But here only the first head alone came out, in Katnut, in three within three, and the two lower heads, which are Arich Anpin and AVI, were not included at all in this coupling; only after the Gadlut of Atik had also come out did the coupling of the Katnut of Arich Anpin begin, and likewise, after the completion of the Katnut and Gadlut of Arich Anpin, the Katnut of AVI began. And the reason for this change is that the three heads of Nekudim are, in truth, only a single degree, since because of the ascent of the bottom Hey to the eyes, the AHP that came out of every degree went outward, hence they divided into three heads, such that the GAR of Nekudim are the AHP that came out from the first head and became the body and HGT. And the GAR of Nekudim themselves also divided, likewise because of the going out of the AHP of Keter of Nekudim outward, as explained in Part 6. And at the time of Gadlut, it is found that every lower one returned to the one above it, being its AHP, in such a way that the second head joined with the first head and completed the first head to ten Sefirot. But since there is no absence in the spiritual, it is considered that the lower one also remained in its place and was not cancelled because of its ascent and its completion to the one above. And likewise the third head, which is the AHP of the second head, rose and joined and completed the second head to a complete ten Sefirot. And as mentioned, still the third head was not cancelled, but remained in its place as well. And you see that the lower one is truly half the ten Sefirot of the one above, namely its Bina and ZON.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:11
items.html: And therefore, at the time the coupling was made in the head of SAG for the sake of Atik, which is the first head of Atzilut, the one below it, which is Arich Anpin, could not be included in this coupling as in Nekudim. For it was flawed in the breaking of the vessels, since it had joined and connected with the first head and completed it to ten Sefirot, and afterward was cancelled because of the breaking and returned and came out of the degree and fell to the aspect of a body. Hence the records of the second head, which is Arich Anpin, are flawed, and are not now fit for coupling, since there is no coupling except in records that have no flaw at all. Hence only the upper half of Keter was corrected, which is in the standing of Atzilut, the aspect of the first head. And the AHP of the point of Keter are not included at all in the coupling, being flawed from the breaking of the vessels. But afterward, at the time the coupling of the Gadlut of Atik was made, when the bottom Hey descended from the forehead to its place in the mouth, and the AHP of Atik returned again to the head, this correction reached the second head as well, which is Arich Anpin, for that flaw of the cancellation of the light and its descent, of the AHP, to the body, was already corrected fully through the Gadlut of Atik. For the AHP that returned to Atik, and the second head, which is Arich Anpin, are truly one and the same aspect, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:12
items.html: Action 9. It is that the coarseness of the body in the records over which the coupling was made became recognized. And this follows from their inclusion in the coupling of the head of SAG, as explained in Part 6.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:13
items.html: Action 10. It is the birth of the Partzuf, namely its going out from the head of SAG and its coming to its place. And this follows from action 9 mentioned above, for after the coarseness in it was recognized, being of the aspect of the chest of Keter of Nekudim, namely the mouth of Arich Anpin of Nekudim, considered as HGT of Keter, as mentioned, this recognition pushes it out from the head of SAG and stands it at the place of the mouth of AVI of Nekudim. For from the mouth of Nekudim and above, it brings out the ten Sefirot of the head, and from the mouth downward it brings out the ten Sefirot of the body, as explained in Part 6.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:14
items.html: Action 11. It is the clarifications of the vessels of BON, meaning the old vessels that had already served at the time of Nekudim, which the new level that now came out in Atzilut needs to fill with its lights, in the manner customary in every lower Partzuf, which fills with its lights the vessels of the upper Partzuf that were emptied of their lights because of the refinement of the screen, as is known. And this is a consequence of action 10, which is the place of the clothing of the Partzuf, for since Atik clothes, with the ten Sefirot of its head, from the mouth of AVI of Nekudim and above until the Tabur of AK, it is found of itself that it fills with its lights the vessels of Nekudim that remained standing there at this place, which are the GAR of Nekudim from the aspect of Katnut, which are the internal organs of the point of Keter, and the Galgalta and Einayim of AVI, which are the aspects of the vessels of the face that the breaking and total cancellation did not rule over. And from the aspect of the vessels, they are counted as the GAR of Keter and the GAR of AVI; also the Hesed of Ima is found there in the internal organs of Ima, for the Hesed does not come out of the GAR of Ima except at the time of Gadlut, in the illumination of Hochma, as is known. So that it has GAR of Keter, also called the upper half of Keter, and GAR of Aba, and GAR of Ima.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:15
items.html: Action 12. It is the ascent as MAN to AB SAG, for after the Partzuf was born, it returns and rises as MAN, for the coupling of AB SAG of AK. And this follows from action 5, from the fact that the screen is included from two kinds of records: from the records of SAG, and from the records of NHY of AK, see there, for at first the records of the first kind rise to the coupling, being of the aspect of the screen itself, which is the essence of every Partzuf, which by the power of the clash of inner light in surrounding light continues to bring out all the degrees in the worlds, both in general and in particular.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:16
items.html: The general levels it comprises are AK and ABYA, for Galgalta AB SAG brought out the aspect of AK from restriction one. And MA brought out Nekudim, and BON brought out Atzilut, and VOK are VAK of Atzilut, as is known. Thus the essential properties of all the Partzufim come from the records of the first kind, from which came the Katnut of Nekudim and the Katnut of Atzilut. However, the records of the second kind are not from the essence of the screen, but rather joined with it at the time the points of SAG expanded from the Tabur downward of AK, in order to correct the NHY of AK, as above, in Part 6. Hence the screen is also included from the records of NHY of AK, and hence they rose with it after the refinement of the screen of SAG, and became the aspect of MAN for the coupling of AB and SAG.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:17
items.html: And therefore, at first the aspects of the records of the first kind rise to the coupling, which is the record of the coarseness remaining in the screen, from which the Katnut of the Partzuf comes out and is born; and afterward, the records of the second kind, which joined with it, are aroused in the screen, as above, whose action is the ascent as MAN to AB SAG, which brings AVI back face to face, from whose coupling the new light comes out, breaking through the Parsa, and bringing the bottom Hey down to its place, as at restriction one, as is known. And through this the Gadlut of the Partzuf is revealed.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:18
items.html: Action 13, it is the coupling of AB SAG, which are Hochma and Bina of AK. And this is a consequence of action 11 mentioned above, which is the records of the second kind that rose to them as MAN. For these records, their root being from the aspect of NHY of AK, which are the aspect of ZON that have no revelation except in the illumination of Hochma, hence at the time of their coming to SAG of AK, which is Bina, they arouse in her the will to bestow upon them the illumination of Hochma, because of the bond of ZON to Bina, in the ten Sefirot of AVI, as is known. And then Bina cuts off her posterior that is upon Hochma, and turns her face to AB, and couples with it. And since AB has no root at all for restriction two, hence its illumination to SAG brings down the bottom Hey from the forehead, in the records that rose as MAN and were included in SAG, and their AHP returns to the degree and the bottom Hey descends to the mouth, and brings out the level of Keter.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:19
items.html: Action 14, it is the bringing down of the bottom Hey from the forehead to the mouth, and the return of the AHP, which are the aspect of the lower half of Keter, to the degree. This is a consequence of action 13, namely of the coupling of AB SAG, as above. However, this AHP is not the aspect of the second head itself, which is Arich Anpin, but rather, as above, at the time of the Gadlut of Nekudim, after they received the new light that broke through the Parsa through the Tabur of AK, every lower one was elevated and joined to the one above, because the lower one is the aspect of half the degree of the one above; however, this ascent does not cancel the degree of the lower one from its place below, but on one hand it is considered that the lower one joined the one above and completed it to ten Sefirot, and on the other hand it is considered that the lower one entirely still stands in its place, as above in action 9, see there, for the reason that there is no absence in the spiritual. And by this you will also understand here that although by the power of the illumination of the coupling of AB SAG, the bottom Hey descended to the mouth, of the records of the point of Keter, and raised and joined the lower half of Keter to the degree, which are its missing AHP, this takes nothing away from the lower half of Keter, which is Arich Anpin, just as the joining of the second head to the first head takes nothing away from the second head itself, as above. For the nature of the spiritual is that it never receives absence, and every change said of it is only an addition to its original measure. And remember this, for it is impossible to mention it always.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:20
items.html: Action 15. It is the coupling made there at the level of Keter. This follows from action 14, which is the bringing down of the bottom Hey to the place of the mouth, and from action 5, which is the records included in the screen, namely the renewal of the records of Gadlut that had been in the point of Keter of Nekudim, which had the level of Keter there. (Note from our master the author, may his memory be blessed: it should be examined why the last phase was not cancelled here. And it may be said that in the mixing of phase four into phase two, the last phase does not disappear as in Keter of Nekudim and Daat; rather, when the bottom Hey descends to its place, it is revealed in its full measure.) And this is because this bottom Hey is truly phase four, but it joined into the first Hey, and its coarseness was hidden, and this concealment is only from restriction two; but after the illumination of the coupling of AB SAG breaks through the Parsa and brings back the illumination of restriction one, then together with this the bottom Hey is revealed in its coarseness as it is, for the first Hey no longer covers it, even though the Parsa in the throat of the intestines of AK is not cancelled.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:21
items.html: Action 16, it is the raising of the sparks and the vessels belonging to this level, from BYA to Atzilut. This is a consequence of action 15, namely of the coupling of the level of Keter, for after the records of the vessels were corrected, the correction rises together also to those vessels to which the records relate. And they become fit for the clothing of those lights that came out for their sake at the level of the coupling. For MA corrects BON just as every lower Partzuf fills the empty vessels of the one above it.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:22
items.html: Action 17, it is the recognition of the coarseness that is revealed in the screen and in the records after the coupling in the head of the one above is completed. This too is a consequence of action 15, for through the inclusion in the coupling of the one above, the essence of the coarseness of the records is renewed, and their earlier form is revealed, from the time this level was in them, namely at the time of Nekudim before the cancellation and the breaking, namely the aspect below the Tabur of AK that is in them, whose place of the screen is in the chest of the point of Keter, which is the mouth of AVI of Nekudim, for AVI are the aspect of the AHP that descended to HGT, from the standing of Keter, and the mouth of AVI is the chest of Keter.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:23
items.html: Action 18, the birth of the Partzuf, and its descent to its place with the new Mochin of Gadlut, is a consequence of action 17, which is the recognition of the coarseness in the screen and the records, which reveals in them the measure of the degree that they had at first, as above. Hence the screen descended from the head of SAG to the place of the mouth of Nekudim, where its source was at first, and the same coupling that was in it at the time of its inclusion in the head of the one above returned upon it, and it brought out, from the mouth upward, ten Sefirot at the level of Keter, and from the mouth downward, ten Sefirot of the body. And then the Partzuf is considered born and complete.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:24
items.html: Action 19, it is that the Hochma and Bina of the head stand back to back toward Atik. And this is a consequence of the nature of Bina, still within the ten Sefirot of AVI, in the secret that “for He desires mercy,” for she pushes away Hochma because of her longing for Hassadim, as is known. Hence it is considered that Hochma and Bina stand back to back.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:25
items.html: Action 20, it is that there is only the aspect of Ruach and Nefesh alone in the body of Atik. And this follows from action 19, from the power of Bina standing back to back with the Hochma of the head, hence it does not bestow the illumination of Hochma to the body, and hence there is only Nefesh and Ruach alone in it.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:26
items.html: Action 21, the clarifications of the vessels of BON belonging to the Gadlut of GAR, and the seven crowns of ZAT of Nekudim, namely from the aspect of what ZAT of Nekudim received from Keter.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:27
items.html: Action 22, it is the standing of MA and BON back to back, where the front side, on the right and left, is entirely the aspect of MA, and the back side, on the right and left, is entirely the aspect of BON. And they are attached to one another, until they are counted as a single Partzuf alone. And this is a consequence of the great extent of the Gadlut in the BON of Atik itself, which is every aspect of the GAR of Nekudim as they came out from the light of the eyes, without any change either in the lights or in the vessels, except that they lack GAR because of the bottom Hey that rose to the eyes. And since they are fully complete in the light of Hassadim, hence they did not become, from the aspect of the Hassadim, a Nukva to Atik, and hence the standing of MA and BON in Atik is not on the right and left, for the coupling of right and left is only for the drawing of Hassadim, and this they do not lack. Hence there is no left in this Atik. Rather, they need the Gadlut for GAR, and only from this aspect are they counted as a Nukva to MA of Atik, and hence they stand front and back. For the coupling from front to back indicates the flow of GAR.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:28
items.html: Action 23, it is the ascent of the screen and the records from the aspect of Arich Anpin, for the coupling of Katnut, to the head of Atik, namely the records of the lower half of Keter. This is a consequence of the clarifications of the vessels of BON, belonging to the Gadlut of Atik, namely of action 20 mentioned above. For then the lower half of Keter, namely the AHP of Keter, received its full correction. And although they do not belong to Arich Anpin, as above, still, since they are truly one and the same aspect, hence the completion of the AHP of Atik also completed Arich Anpin from the flaw that was in it since the time of the breaking, and hence it too became fit to rise for the coupling.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:29
items.html: And you need to know here the rule that applies in all the clarifications: that all the records of Nekudim together rose at once to the head of SAG, where only the Partzuf Atik was clarified from them, as above, and then all the remaining records after Partzuf Atik are considered refuse, and all descended into the domain of the lower one, which is Atik, and after this Atik clarified from the totality of the records the aspect of Arich Anpin within them, and the records remaining after the clarification of Arich Anpin are then considered refuse, and descended to the lower one, which is Arich Anpin. And likewise Arich Anpin clarified from them AVI, and the rest are refuse in relation to it, and descended to the lower one, which is AVI, and so on in this way until the end of Assiya, as above in the words of the ARI (page 492, item 12, until the end of the matter there). And the reason for the matter you will see here in action 8, under “and therefore,” for at the time the Katnut of Atik was clarified in the head of SAG, even its own AHP were flawed, for the coupling to bring the bottom Hey down from the forehead was not yet there, and how much more so Arich Anpin, whose aspect of AHP is certainly flawed, needless to say the degrees below Arich Anpin. Thus, at the time of the ascent of the screen and the records to the head of SAG, it was not possible to clarify from them, for the purpose of coupling, anything but the aspect of the Katnut of Atik, which is from the records of the upper half of the point of Keter, which alone is without flaw and fit for coupling, but its own AHP, and how much more Arich Anpin and the rest of the degrees, were then flawed and considered refuse, and hence descended from there to the domain of Atik, which is the lower one.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:30
items.html: But after the Gadlut of Atik was also corrected, through the coupling of AB SAG, as above in action 13, which brought the bottom Hey down below the AHP, and the AHP of Atik returned to the aspect of the head, together with this Arich Anpin was corrected, which is the lower half of Keter, and hence immediately the coupling of Katnut was made over the records of Arich Anpin. However, AVI, whose aspect is the AHP of Arich Anpin, are still found flawed, since Arich Anpin had not yet received the illumination of the coupling of AB SAG to bring the bottom Hey down below its own AHP, hence its own AHP are still flawed, needless to say AVI, who are the complete AHP of Arich Anpin. Needless to say the remaining degrees below AVI. Thus, at the time the totality of the MAN is found in the domain of Atik, it can clarify from them only the aspect of the Katnut of Arich Anpin alone, and the totality of all the records below Arich Anpin, and also the records of the AHP of Arich Anpin itself among them, are all flawed and considered refuse then. And so it was with all the clarifications.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:31
items.html: Action 24, it is the coupling made over the records of Arich Anpin in the forehead of Atik, which is a consequence of action 23. Action 25, it is the coming out of the level of three within three, a consequence of action 24, since there are no vessels except from the aspect of Keter, which is the level of NHY, and the level of HGT of clothing clothed in NHY. Action 26, the revelation of the original coarseness in the records, a consequence of action 25, which is through inclusion in the coupling. Action 27, it is the birth of Arich Anpin and its coming to its place, a consequence of action 26. Action 28, it is the clarification and raising of the vessels and sparks of BON to Atzilut, belonging to the Katnut of Arich Anpin, a consequence of action 27, namely of its coming to its place, and it clothes Atik from the mouth downward, as above in action 11. And with these six actions the Katnut of Arich Anpin was completed.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:32
items.html: Action 29, it is the ascent as MAN to AB SAG, following from action 24, since through the coupling made in the forehead, the records of the second kind remained without correction, as above in action 12. Action 30, it is the coupling of AB SAG, a consequence of action 29. Action 31, it is the bringing down of the bottom Hey and the return of the AHP to the degree, a consequence of action 30. Action 32, it is the level of Hochma that came out there, a consequence of action 31, except that no records of Gadlut of Nekudim remained there, only the coarseness of phase three, since Atik took phase four. Action 33, it is the raising of the sparks and vessels of Gadlut from BYA to Atzilut, a consequence of action 32, for in the same measure that the records were corrected in the head of the one above, so they raise the vessels and sparks from BYA, as above in action 15. Action 34, the recognition of the coarseness in the records, a consequence of action 32, as above in action 16. Action 35, the birth of the level of Gadlut, a consequence of action 34. Action 36, it is the clarification of the vessels of Gadlut of BON for the aspect of the Nukva of Arich Anpin, a consequence of action 35, for after it was born and came to its place, it is found clothing the vessels of the one above, which is Nekudim, that were clarified through the upper coupling and raised to the place of the standing of MA of Arich Anpin, and hence it fills them with its lights. Action 37, it is the standing of the male and the female, namely MA and BON of Arich Anpin, in its Partzuf, where MA stands on the right and BON on the left, a consequence of the cancellation that was in the vessels of BON of Arich Anpin, at the time of Nekudim, whereby they became, for this, lacking in Hassadim. And the coupling of the bestowal of Hassadim is considered the standing of male and female on the right and left. Action 38, it is the standing of AVI of the head of Arich Anpin back to back, because of the Bina of the head, which chooses Hassadim over Hochma. Action 39, it is the level of Ruach and Nefesh in the ten Sefirot of the body of Arich Anpin, a consequence of action 38, from the standing back to back. And thus the ten actions that come to complete the Gadlut of the Partzuf of Arich Anpin have been explained.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:33
items.html: And these six actions in the Katnut of Arich Anpin, together with the ten actions in the Gadlut of Arich Anpin, apply to all the Partzufim of Atzilut, and there is no need to repeat and specify them, for they follow and are consequent from one another, exactly in the same order brought concerning Arich Anpin. And likewise the matter of their coming out and their clarification from Partzuf to Partzuf is according to the order of the clarification of the head of SAG for Atik, as above, and according to the order of the clarification of the head of Atik for Arich Anpin, as above. For every lower Partzuf is in the aspect of the AHP of the upper Partzuf, as above in action 23, and hence, before the Gadlut of the upper Partzuf is corrected, namely its own AHP, they are still found in their flaw, needless to say the lower one, which is the branch of the AHP of the one above, and the aspect of the body, is certainly flawed and unfit for coupling. And from this the rule follows: that before the Gadlut of the one above is corrected, the Katnut in the lower one is not fit even for coupling. And this applies to all the Partzufim.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 97:34
items.html: And therefore, all these sixteen actions that we explained in the Partzuf of Arich Anpin apply also to: AVI, and Yeshsut, and the great ZON, and the small ZON, and also to the soul of Adam HaRishon. We have brought here only the general rules, namely only the headings of the actions. Indeed, for every single rule there are found many particular actions, which we were compelled to pass over, for lack of much knowledge that we still have, which will come, God willing, in the coming parts, and there we will return and explain every rule together with the particulars attributed to it, by way of cause and consequence at proper length. And then we will be able to arrange them one after another without skipping, God willing.
